user.title: Welcome to HATickerSec
user.description:
**Breaking News feeds**, right in Home Assistant. HATickerSec brings the latest headlines from trusted news and security sources and scrolls them in sleek, glassy tickers.

Choose up to **4** categories to start with. Each one comes with its trusted sources, ready to go — you can fine-tune everything later in the **HATickerSec** panel in the sidebar ({count} sources to pick from).

data.categories: What would you like to follow?

data_description.position: Top or bottom docks the tickers across every Home Assistant screen (each device can switch this off). You can also add the HATickerSec card to any dashboard.

error.too_many: You can choose up to 4 — remove one to continue.

abort.single_instance_allowed: HATickerSec is already set up. Open the HATickerSec panel in the sidebar to change it.

refresh.name: Refresh now
refresh.description: Fetch every enabled news source right away.

preview.name: Preview
preview.description: Show what an alert looks like on every screen.

kind.name: What to preview
kind.description: new, keyword, breaking, glow, popup-keyword, popup-breaking, ha, chime, chime-breaking or everything.

test_alert.name: Test alert
test_alert.description: Send a test alert the way alerts are set to pop up.

toggle_category.name: Collapse or expand a category
toggle_category.description: Show a category as one combined bar, or one bar per source.
